easyPrerequisites: Dual Casting and Umbral Mantle are attached to the same creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Seething Song by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Seething Song.
Resolve the copy of Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}
Activate the creature by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.
